description: This file implements command-line flag parsing and registration for the c10 library, including functions for setting usage messages, parsing flags, and handling different data types.

methods.name: SetUsageMessage
methods.description: Sets the usage message string for command-line help.

methods.name: UsageMessage
methods.description: Returns the current usage message string.

methods.name: ParseCommandLineFlags
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to set flags, handling help, unrecognized flags, and errors.

methods.name: CommandLineFlagsHasBeenParsed
methods.description: Checks if command-line flags have been parsed.
